title: Menu Zainab Aakh Bulande Ne Mar Jaawan Gi Veera
body:
Kadi Naizay Maar Turande Ne, Abid Un Khoon Ruwande Ne,
Vich Galiyan Pathar Vasaande Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
<<DIVIDER>>
Is Haal Ch Shaam Bazaar Andar Assi Pandraan Azaanan Suniyan,
Jadoun Naam Rasool Da Chaande Ne, Awaazan Maarde Jaande Ne,
Sadi Chadraan Nu Lehranday Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
<<DIVIDER>>
Has Has Ke Mubarakan Denday Ne, Ik Doosre Nu Ay Zalim,
Mouran Te Majmay Laande Ne, Zardar Poshakan Pande Ne,
Tere Qatal Te Jashan Manande Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
<<DIVIDER>>
Sir Jeri Saang Te Asghar Da, Odhe Saamne Aakay Shaami,
Sir Saang Ton Aan Girande Ne, Sada Saara Poor Ruwande Ne,
Te Apne Baal Hasande Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Haal Sakina Da Keeta, Vich Shaam De Safar Siphaiyan,
Chup Vekh Ke Aan Satande Ne, Tera Sir Dikhla Ke Ruwande Ne,
Fer Maar Khamoush Karande Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar Bibi Ay Vain Karay, Sir Veer Hussain Da Tak Ke,
Tak Kinj Ay Veer Satande Ne, Sadi Haalat Vekh De Jaande Ne,
Te Apne Sadqay Lahande Ne, Mar Jaawan Gi Veera,
